displayName: OCI-AI-DB-004: AI — Embedding Model Evasion Attack
description:
Detects adversarial inputs designed to evade embedding-based similarity search and retrieve wrong documents

⚠️ NEEDS-REWRITE: Query is generic SQL, needs conversion to Cloud Guard detector condition

dataSourceDetails.query: SELECT "siem_general_ai_db_004", "data__json.message" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'OciLoggingService' AND ("data__json.message" LIKE '%embedding%' OR "data__json.message" LIKE '%model%') AND "value" > 0
